rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the new HIGH bug: the original rebrand sweep replaced the plain word 'Addrika' with '${BRAND.name}' inside JSX text nodes without converting the surrounding text to a template literal or to '{BRAND.name}'. React then interpolates '{BRAND.name}' as an expression but keeps the preceding '$' as literal text, producing '$Addrika'. Because these JSX text nodes span multiple lines, neither audit regex (which requires quotes or a '>'/'<' on the same line) matches, so brand-audit.js exits 0. Reproduction: curl won't show it (pages are client-rendered); open https://fragrance-rewards.preview.emergentagent.com/our-quality in a browser and read the hero paragraph — 'At $Addrika, quality isn't just a promise'. Mitigation: mechanical '${BRAND.name}' -> '{BRAND.name}' replacement on the 42 grep-identified lines plus a no-backtick audit rule.
